title: Rename AppSource UI text to Marketplace
summary: User-facing text that references AppSource has been updated to use Marketplace terminology throughout the application and system components.
key_points: User-facing captions, tooltips, labels and instructional text now say Marketplace instead of AppSource
Covers Connectivity Apps, E-Documents, Recommended Apps, CRM/Dataverse setup, Power BI and System Application wizards and the gallery
Technical identifiers, object names, URL constants and AppSourceCop/config references are unchanged
Ports the matching text changes from a Dynamics SMB NAV PR
Recommended Apps tests and AppSource Gallery app.json metadata updated
quote: Update additional user-facing captions, tooltips, labels, instructional text, and visible metadata.
